label: B25-NOFP-BRINGUP-PROFILE
title: Freeze a scalar no-FP board profile for fast corrected bring-up
scope: Create a derivative of the corrected integration candidate whose Catapult board top defaults A64_FP_SIMD to 0. The resident monitor is scalar-only, so this removes unused FP/NEON execution units to reduce the first-feedback Quartus synthesis from the historical full-FP multi-hour path toward the measured no-FP ~362-second synthesis class.

profile_contract.purpose: First-board PC=0 -> polling JTAG-UART -> DDR diagnostic only
profile_contract.software: The B25 monitor executes no FP/NEON instruction.
profile_contract.architecture_limit: A64_FP_SIMD=0 removes FP/NEON execution units and is not a final P7/full-FP release profile. Software must not execute FP/NEON; this task does not claim complete UDEF/trap semantics for such instructions.
profile_contract.integration_policy: Keep this as an explicitly labeled topic/profile SHA for physical and board feedback. Do not silently replace the full-FP integration baseline or call it Gate F-RELEASE.

validation.diff: Exactly one functional source change: board-top A64_FP_SIMD default 1 -> 0.
validation.L0: no-FP core/SoC lint and parameter propagation check
validation.L1: B25 BRAM/M20K focused and platform/synthesis-selector closure remain green
validation.L2: lcvex_catapult_soc_tb built with -GA64_FP_SIMD=0 passes CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL, READY, PONG, echo and DDR count checks

acceptance: The profile removes FP/NEON instances, retains the corrected M20K RTL and passes the scalar B25 boot/interaction simulations. Evidence clearly labels it non-release and binds the exact profile SHA for fresh physical flow.
resource: Small lint/static checks may run unlocked. The no-FP SoC binary/smoke must acquire local; return 75 means wait. This task itself performs no GamePC or board action.
forbidden_regions: core A64_FP_SIMD default or FP/NEON implementation
boot monitor, cache, AXI, EMIF, BRAM, UART, QSF or SDC changes
next_after_acceptance: T-20260919-004 fitter/STA is released on the exact profile SHA; assembler remains gated by both T-20260919-002 Gate D and T-20260919-004 physical acceptance.
